correctness.rationale: Construct F25=F5[u]/(u²−2) and the 12 nonzero quadratic residues, then P25 neighbors by nonzero square differences. Independently regenerated srg parameters (25,12,5,6) and union of all subsets of open neighborhoods: exactly 93,350 nonempty faces with stated f-vector through dimension 11. Rebuilt legal free-face collapse algorithm to 6,258 faces in 43,546 exact elementary collapses; then entire oriented 6,258-vertex Hasse digraph for 2,967 Morse pairs with one critical vertex, 262 critical 3-cells and 61 critical 4-cells. Independently reconstructed signed gradient-path differential (262 rows,61 columns,923 nonzeros) and computed exact integer Smith normal form using SymPy: 56 factors 1, one factor 5 (rank 57). Therefore Htilde3=Z^(262−57)⊕Z/5=Z^205⊕Z/5, Htilde4=Z^(61−57)=Z^4, remaining reduced homology 0. Correctly uses *open* neighborhoods; mod2/mod5 ranks alone would not prove integral torsion type.
